description: TOPS, published by hallvar-h, provides Python power flow, RMS or phasor dynamic simulation, linearisation and eigenvalue analysis for research and education. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is MIT. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The README calls some features experimental and says performance is not the main priority. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support network flow, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: No directly related catalogue record was established from the reviewed sources.
